Add a customer receipt-download endpoint before the Friday release. It must let a signed-in customer download only that
customer's receipt. The release must be deployable without manual secret changes, preserve the project's third-party
notice obligations, remain responsive for large receipts, explain a denied download in plain language, and have
automated verification of the authorization and download behavior.

The implementation, release manifest, license notice, and delivery plan are the files in this fixture.

item.text:
## Architecture

- `ReceiptDownloadEndpoint` hard-codes `/srv/receipts` instead of using the declared `RECEIPT_DIRECTORY` setting. Inject configuration and a receipt service that resolves receipts by authenticated customer and receipt ID. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:6)

## Business

- The endpoint accepts only `receiptName`; it has no customer identity or ownership check, so it cannot enforce “only that customer’s receipt.” Require authenticated principal plus a receipt lookup that verifies customer ownership before returning content. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:5)

## Deployment

- The release manifest embeds `PAYMENT_API_KEY: development-key`, contradicting deployability without manual secret changes and exposing a credential in deployment configuration. Replace it with the platform’s managed secret reference and supply the release value through normal secret provisioning. [release.yaml](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/deploy/release.yaml:4)
- The image uses mutable `latest`, preventing a reproducible release. Pin an immutable version or image digest. [release.yaml](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/deploy/release.yaml:1)

## Design

- The download method returns raw bytes and throws `Exception`, leaving response status, content type, attachment filename, and expected errors undefined. Define explicit success and denial/not-found responses with safe download headers. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:5)

## Legal

- The notice identifies modified Apache-2.0 code but does not include the Apache-2.0 license text or any required upstream NOTICE attribution. Add the license text, preserve applicable upstream notices, and identify local modifications. [THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md:3)

## Performance

- `Files.readAllBytes` loads each entire receipt into memory; with a 128Mi limit this can fail or degrade responsiveness for large receipts. Stream the file to the response with bounded buffering and size limits. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:6) [release.yaml](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/deploy/release.yaml:6)

## Requirements

- The declared signed-in and customer-specific authorization requirements are not implemented. Add authentication and an ownership authorization check before accessing receipt data. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:5)

## Security

- Untrusted `receiptName` is resolved directly against the receipt directory; values such as `../...` can escape that directory, and absolute paths may replace it. Do not accept filesystem paths from clients; use an opaque receipt ID, resolve it server-side, and enforce normalized containment as defense in depth. [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:6)

## Testing

- No automated tests are included despite the declared requirement to verify authorization and download behavior. Add tests for unauthenticated access, cross-customer denial, authorized download, traversal attempts, large-receipt streaming, and the denial message.

## UX

- “Request 4f2a9c failed. Contact support.” does not plainly explain a denied download. Return a clear, non-sensitive message such as “You don’t have permission to download this receipt.” [ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/src/ReceiptDownloadEndpoint.java:10)

## Plan Review

- The delivery plan omits authorization implementation, automated verification, secret provisioning, legal-notice completion, large-file handling, immutable release pinning, and release validation. Add these as explicit completion criteria before announcement. [PLAN.md](/home/gili/cat/worktrees/v1.0/docs/changelog/1.0/captures/reviews/languages/java/runs/codex-base-structured/codex/msp6sd0n-b60eqoooz6/project/PLAN.md:3)
